samples.text:
The maps show a riverside district of a city in 1990 and 2025. Overall, the district changed from an industrial area to a area for living, working and leisure, and some new paths was built.

In 1990, the River Tane went through the middle of the district from west to east, and Old Bridge crossed it on the east side. To the north of the river there was a factory, some warehouses and wasteland. To the south there were terraced housing and a power station, and the south-east was empty.

In 2025, the factory has been converted to apartments and the warehouses were replaced by offices. The wasteland became a riverside park. On the south side, the terraced housing is still there, but the power station is now an arts centre. Also, a car park has been built in the south-east. In addition, there is a riverside walkway along the north side of the river and a footbridge over the river from the housing to the north side. The roads and Old Bridge stayed the same.
samples.why: Overview present but general · all key changes covered · mechanical linking (Also, In addition) · adequate vocabulary · several errors in articles, agreement and tense that do not affect understanding.

samples.text:
The maps compare a riverside district of a city in 1990 and 2025. Overall, the area has changed from an industrial district into one used for housing, business and leisure, with former industrial buildings either converted or replaced, and new routes created for pedestrians.

The basic road network has remained the same, with North Road and South Road running along the northern and southern edges and Old Bridge crossing the River Tane in the east. The terraced housing in the south-west has also been kept.

North of the river, the factory in the north-west has been converted into apartments, while the warehouses next to it have been replaced by offices. The wasteland in the north-east, on the other side of Old Bridge, has been turned into a riverside park. South of the river, the power station has become an arts centre, and a car park has been built on the empty land in the south-east.

In addition, two new footpaths have appeared. A riverside walkway now run along the northern bank of the river for its full length, and a footbridge has been constructed across the river, linking the terraced housing area with the north bank.
samples.why: Clear overview · changes organised logically by area · effective cohesion · good vocabulary (converted, business and leisure) · mostly accurate with an agreement slip.

samples.text:
The maps illustrate the transformation of a city's riverside district between 1990 and 2025. The overall picture is one of post-industrial regeneration: heavy industry and derelict land have given way to homes, workplaces and cultural and leisure facilities, while the district's road network and its residential streets in the south-west have survived unchanged.

On the northern bank of the River Tane, the factory has been converted into apartments, and the neighbouring warehouses have been replaced by an office development. Further east, beyond Old Bridge, the wasteland has been landscaped as a riverside park. These buildings are now fronted by a riverside walkway that follows the northern bank along the whole width of the district.

South of the river, the terraced housing remains in place, but the power station beside it has been repurposed as an arts centre, and the previously undeveloped land to the east of Old Bridge has been turned into a car park. Finally, pedestrian access across the river has been improved by a new footbridge, which links the eastern end of the terraced housing with the northern bank, between the apartments and the offices.
samples.why: Insightful overview of regeneration · changes precisely located and logically grouped by bank · cohesion natural and varied · sophisticated vocabulary (derelict, repurposed, fronted by) · wide range of accurate structures.
